portrait_prompt: A single brass saxophone displayed as a still life, illustrated cinematic style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. The instrument has a warm gold-lacquered brass body with a long straight conical tube, an elegantly curved neck ending in a black hard-rubber mouthpiece with a metal ligature, and a wide flaring bell that curves forward and upward. Rows of circular brass keys with pearl-white touchpieces run down the front and sides of the body, connected by a network of slender metal rods, springs, and hinged key cups with leather pads. The saxophone stands upright at a slight diagonal, bell facing toward the viewer, catching soft directional light that creates warm highlights and deep amber shadows along its polished curves. Background is a deep muted solid color (dark teal or warm charcoal), subtly textured but nearly flat, with no other objects or people. The painting fills the entire canvas edge to edge, no border, no vignette, no frame, no text.

middle_slides.text: 1840年代、ベルギーの楽器職人アドルフ・サックスは、木管の柔らかさと金管の力強さを併せ持つ新楽器サクソフォンを考案した。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. Inside a cluttered 1840s Belgian instrument workshop in Brussels, the instrument maker Adolphe Sax in his thirties, drawn with the face, dark hair and full dark beard of the attached reference photograph, stands at a wooden workbench facing the viewer, examining a newly assembled brass instrument. He wears a simple white shirt with a dark waistcoat typical of the 1840s, sleeves rolled up. On the workbench lies an early prototype saxophone: a large conical brass tube with a gently curved neck, a single-reed mouthpiece, and a sparse row of brass keys, its bell only slightly flared. Tools, brass tubing offcuts, clarinet and ophicleide parts hang on the walls, warm lamplight glows from a single window, rich browns and ambers.

middle_slides.text: 1846年に特許を取得したが、新しすぎる楽器は既存の楽器商や演奏家から猛反発を受け、木管でも金管でもないと酷評され続けた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. A grand 19th-century Parisian music shop interior, mid-1840s. A group of formally dressed instrument dealers and musicians in dark tailcoats and top hats stand in a semicircle, their faces showing skepticism and scorn, gesturing dismissively toward a gleaming brass saxophone displayed on a velvet-draped pedestal in the center of the room. The saxophone has a conical brass body, a curved neck with dark mouthpiece, and a moderately flared bell with rows of brass keys, resting beside a rolled patent document tied with ribbon. Ornate shelves lined with violins, clarinets, and brass horns frame the background, warm gaslight illuminates the scene, rich deep reds and browns dominate the palette, tension visible in the crowd's posture and expressions.

middle_slides.text: ライバル業者は特許の正当性を執拗に訴え続け、長期化した訴訟の末、サックスは1856年と1873年の2度にわたり破産した。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. A somber 19th-century Parisian legal office scene, 1850s-1870s. Adolphe Sax in his forties to fifties, drawn with the face and full dark beard of the attached reference photograph, sits at a heavy wooden table facing the viewer with a serious, weary expression, in a dark formal frock coat with a white cravat. Stacks of legal papers and ledgers are spread before him; in the background blurred silhouettes of stern lawyers stand behind a raised bench. To one side a brass saxophone with a curved neck and flared bell rests upright in an open velvet-lined case. Muted grays, deep browns and somber candlelight, conveying financial ruin and legal struggle.

middle_slides.text: それでも彼は楽器製作と音楽院での指導を続け、サクソフォンは軍楽隊を経て、今や世界中の音楽に欠かせない楽器となった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. A warm, light-filled classroom at the Paris Conservatoire in the late 19th century. Adolphe Sax, a distinguished man in his fifties with the face and full beard of the attached reference photograph (beard now graying), in a dark formal frock coat, stands at the front facing young students seated with saxophones in their laps, demonstrating with his own brass saxophone held in playing position. Tall arched windows let in golden afternoon light. In the distant background through a window, a small military band marches outdoors with saxophones glinting. Rich warm ochres and soft golds.

fb_caption:
サクソフォンは、発明者を2度も破産に追い込んだ楽器だった。1846年に特許を取得したアドルフ・サックスは、新しすぎる発明ゆえに同業の楽器商から激しい攻撃を受け続けたのだ。✨

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

他の作曲家の逸話も知りたい方は、チャンネルもチェックしてみてください。https://youtube.com/@classicalmusic_note?si=evg6wej2KOx2uPhH
